verdict.rationale: Blaxel sandboxes are documented for code execution. The SDK runs shell commands and processes (blaxel-docs-17) and returns output logs in batch or real-time streams (blaxel-docs-20). Custom images can pre-install languages and frameworks (blaxel-docs-32), so multiple runtimes are reachable, but only through generic process execution rather than a documented multi-language code interpreter, and results come back as logs rather than rich output. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in Python/JavaScript runtimes, rich result types (charts, structured or typed outputs), a language-aware code-run API, independent hands-on corroboration.
